file_impact.reason: Add a typed AcliNotInstalledError(FileNotFoundError) naming the binary + Cloud-path requirement + install-doc remedy, a reusable acli_binary_available()/require_acli() preflight (shutil.which-based), and wire the typed error at the _run_acli Popen spawn site so an absent acli yields the typed guidance error instead of a bare [Errno 2] (AC #2, #3). Subclassing FileNotFoundError keeps ac93's transport-internals handler working (no collision).

Declare acli as a required external binary for the Jira Cloud path with an install pointer, and state the [jira-datacenter] Data Center path does not need it (uses the jira Python library) — AC #1, #4.
Add a non-container/package-install prerequisite note for acli (not only the CI-setup context), pointing pip-install users at the acli install — AC #1.
Strengthen the existing 'System prerequisites (not pip deps): acli' comment to name the Cloud path and the DC exemption, so the packaging metadata reflects the declared contract — AC #1.

RED->GREEN held-out oracle: with acli absent from PATH (real PATH manipulation, not monkeypatched), _run_acli/require_acli raise AcliNotInstalledError naming the binary + remedy; positive control with a stub acli on PATH passes; discrimination test proving missing-binary vs missing-credentials are distinct outcomes (AC #2, #3).
